description: This file provides utilities for aligning and correcting subtitle entries, particularly for SRT format, based on a transcript generated by a Whisper model. It includes functions for normalizing text, adjusting timestamps, matching subtitles to transcript segments, and ensuring monotonic timing.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Check if the provided text is empty or only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Collapse multiple spaces into one and trim whitespace.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculate overlap duration between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculate the center point of a time interval.

methods.name: Any _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely extract a key value from a transcript segment, which can be dict-like or object-like.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_seg_dict(seg: Any)
methods.description: Normalize a segment into a dict with 'start', 'end', and 'text' keys.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Adjust subtitle timings in-place to ensure they are non-overlapping and monotonic.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Find the index of the transcript segment that best matches a subtitle interval based on overlap and proximity.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Find the transcript segment closest to a specific point in time.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merge consecutive subtitles with blank text to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Update subtitle text from transcript segment if missing or blank.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Adjust subtitle start and end times to better fit a transcript segment while maintaining reasonable duration.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles(transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict])
methods.description: Main function to align and correct subtitles, filling missing texts, refining timestamps, and ensuring monotonic timing based on a Whisper transcript.

ctags.name: _get_seg_value
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:$/
ctags.signature: (seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/
